items.headline: Kaiser Aluminum reported record Q2 2026 financial results, with net sales up to $1.26B, conversion revenue up 17%, operating income up to $134M, and adjusted EBITDA up to $166M.

Kaiser Aluminum's Q2 2026 earnings call highlighted improved leverage to 2.1x, free cash flow of $35M, and a quarterly dividend of $0.77 per share, while noting higher planned spending and some second-half margin pressure.
